post_calibration_disclosure.observed_failure: The original fixed banana intersects the bowl's registered negative sweep by -30 mm, making every symmetric r >= 90 mm impossible.
post_calibration_disclosure.design_response: Register a new cohort rather than narrowing or shifting V3-B004. Move only the irrelevant banana distractor to one fixed, model-blind safe pose; retain the originally targeted center and minimum 90 mm half-range.

exact_prompts.left: Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
exact_prompts.right: Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.

held_fixed_within_cohort: rubiks_cube full initial pose at the V3-B001 control value
banana full initial pose at the prospectively registered V3-B005 safe-distractor value
bowl x, z, and quaternion at the V3-B001 control value
robot base, cameras, controller, and all nonmovable geometry
static prompt bytes, success predicate, requested 45-degree cone, and action cap
environment and registered sampling seed within every level-specific LEFT/RIGHT pair

randomization.seeds_9500_9513: deterministic cyclic Latin order over seven levels by two relations
randomization.lane_rule: Never split one seed's 14 cells across runtime lanes

requirements: fresh physical reset is attested before every row
neither requested-relation predicate is true at reset
all four RGB views are nonblank
LEFT and RIGHT physical fingerprints match within 5 mm at every level and repeat
RTX viewport video and append-only JSONL persist on the ali PVC
model_blind_release_gate.failure_rule: If any preregistered level fails, V3-B005 fails closed. Do not move the banana, narrow the range, shift the center, or respacing levels after this amendment.

analysis_plan.inferential_unit: matched seed; repeated levels are within-seed observations
analysis_plan.dose_response: For each seed, regress B on the seven registered bowl-y levels; report all 15 slopes, mean, median, 20,000-seed bootstrap 95% CI, signs, exact sign test, and an in-support zero crossing only.
analysis_plan.binary_success_secondary: Report LEFT/RIGHT successes and Wilson 95% intervals at each level plus paired success_R-minus-success_L slopes.
analysis_plan.success_conditional_margin: Use only level-specific pairs where both directions succeed; report realized n and never encode failure as zero.
analysis_plan.failure_taxonomy: Retain correct/pick/transport/wrong_side/release for every valid episode by level and direction.
analysis_plan.missingness: No imputation. Infrastructure-invalid and partial attempts remain separate and are repaired only as the identical registered cell.

release_boundary.next_command: Run only the exact 42-row V3-B005 zero-model-request physical gate. Commit its hash-bound report and generated 210-cell queue before any Nano model request.
